# vLLM_plugin_FLSDI

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-07-30

## Definition
A plugin for vLLM (virtual large language model) that integrates FLSDI (Flexible Low-latency SDI) for topology-aware memory and communication management. Allows LLM inference to dynamically adapt to TCC network topologies, improving throughput and reducing latency in distributed deployments.
